cause: GStreamer drop-on-latency evicts the oldest queued packet by RTP timestamp span >= latency, independently of deadline and native loss events.

fix.capacity_exhausted_behavior: Revoke this media context; expose jitter_capacity_exhausted. Other bounded ingress and decoded queues are unchanged.

limits: A controlled native output-task scheduling delay reproduces the same local overflow mechanism. Ubuntu was not rerun and its precise scheduling trigger is not proven by these counters.
